collection.title: Smart ForTwo Coupe 2004 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Smart ForTwo Coupe 2004 to 2006 will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this ForTwo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
